name: China Datang Corporation Renewable Power Co., Limited
summary: China Datang Corporation Renewable Power Co., Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment, development, construction, and management of wind power and other renewable energy sources in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Wind Power and Photovaltaic segments.
